extracted.stage: Ongoing matrimonial proceedings, hearing listed, running to settlement or trial
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Mercer Law seeks £34,000 to fund his client's representation in ongoing matrimonial proceedings where the disputed assets are around £685,500 and a hearing is listed for 19 October 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. To progress our review we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and the court in which the proceedings are issued, details of the hearing listed for 19 October and the stage reached, and a breakdown of the £34,000 sought. We would also need supporting information on the composition and value of the matrimonial assets, including how they are held and by whom, together with your client's details for onboarding and identity checks. Once we have those materials a member of the team will come back to you; nothing in this message should be taken as an indication of whether funding can be offered or on what terms.
